_note: What customers say about the shop's AI after dealing with it. Read by infrastructure/server/voices.mjs. Picked by what happened to the customer in the records (outcome) and by their manner (tone), seeded by the contact, so the same run gives the same words. Each opinion is the outcome line, with a `speed` line before it, after it, or not at all (infrastructure/server/voices.mjs varies this), and lines are not reused within one result until the bank runs out. {speed} is filled from `speed` by channel and how fast the first answer came; {order} with their order number or 'my order'. Dry and plain: these are ordinary people describing an ordinary service.
